cells.gaps: The 2010-2025 policy's period has ended; its successor, a PNDTIC 2025-2034 with an action plan, was put out to consultants in November 2023 and nothing since shows it drafted, validated or adopted. No governance fact falls inside the 36 months and nothing is dated in the last twelve months.
cells.note: PNDTIC 2025-2034: announced as the successor when PAFEN called in November 2023 for consultants to evaluate the 2010-2025 policy and draft a new one with its action plan, so the lapsed policy has a successor in preparation, which is stage 2. Stage 3 needs an adopted successor with a public text.
